consequence.statement: Certificates that set spec.renewBeforePercentage will be renewed according to the field's specification instead of the previous incorrect behavior, so renewal timing may change; nothing fails and no resource is rejected.
consequence.remediation: Review renewal timing for Certificate resources that set spec.renewBeforePercentage to confirm the corrected behavior is acceptable.

assertion.statement: cert-manager 1.17.0 fixes the behavior of the Certificate field spec.renewBeforePercentage so that it complies with its specification.
